BigVGAN v2 third-party notices

This vendored runtime keeps only the files needed by the GJJ MMAudio node.
The original upstream package included separate files under incl_licenses/.
Those duplicate license files were consolidated here to reduce vendor size.

BigVGAN v2:
- Copyright (c) 2024 NVIDIA CORPORATION.
- License: MIT. See LICENSE in this directory.

Included/adapted components referenced by the vendored source:
- HiFi-GAN components: Copyright (c) 2020 Jungil Kong, MIT.
- Snake activation: Copyright (c) 2020 Edward Dixon, MIT.
- Alias-free / anti-aliased activation CUDA reference code: Apache-2.0.
- Descript components: Copyright (c) 2023-present, Descript, MIT.
- Charactr components: Copyright (c) 2023 Charactr Inc., MIT.
- Amphion components: Copyright (c) 2023 Amphion, MIT.
- EnCodec reference components: Copyright 2020 Alexandre Defossez, MIT.

The CUDA extension source is not used by this node because BigVGAN is loaded
with use_cuda_kernel=False.
